newsitem.title: USA: Zoom sees increased demand, higher prices.
newsitem.headline: Zoom sees increased demand, higher prices.

text.p: Zoom Telephonics Inc will ship 54 KBPS modems soon and expects to see increased demand and higher average selling prices later this year, which may mean a boost in gross margins, the company's president, Frank Manning said.
The company did not provide specific figures. Officials there were not immediately available to comment.

Manning, who made his comments in a press release that contained the company's 1996 fourth-quarter and full-year results, also said the company's price protection expense rose to $3.5 million in 1996 from $2.2 million in 1995.
Manning said the rising expenses were due to rapidly declining prices -- a trend he sees changing in 1997, he said.
